car.name: Bluebell GT 2006
car.description: Original logo-free 2994 turquoise and coral rounded V6 coupe. US 2006 GT six-speed manual inspiration with dual-final gearbox represented by explicitly effective ratios. Standard chassis; preliminary source caveats retained.

catalogProvenance.inspiration: US 2006 Mitsubishi Eclipse GT coupe standard 6MT FWD LHD, no Premium Sport Package/sunroof, not GS/Spyder/AT

sources.kind: OEM 2006 MMNA technical-information manual, independent archive
fields: Actual pages 00-5 and 00-18 rendered and visually inspected; technical.txt saved. Exact engine, physical gearbox dual-final and manual mass/dimensions.

fields: Read table text; use standard tire/fuel/redline/front split only with preliminary qualification. Its 260hp superseded by technical manual263. GS errors do not apply to selected GT.

estimates: Actual 2006 OEM technical manual anchors 3828 cc, 263 HP at 5750 rpm, 260 lb-ft / 353 Nm at 4500 rpm, 1575 kg manual curb and dimensions. Printed 194 kW and 263 HP are inconsistent; retain published 263 HP, not a claimed exact 194 kW conversion. Rounded torque units retained. No driver/fuel load added to unspecified curb convention.

Physical F6MBA gearbox has final 3.777 on gears 1-4 and 3.238 on 5-6/reverse. Runtime uses arbitrary EFFECTIVE final 4 and overall reductions divided by 4, NOT physical tooth ratios. Full precision configuration preserves reductions; actual editor edits round to .001, bounded error below .002 overall, disclosed and tested.

6500 redline, .62 front weight fraction, standard 225/50R17 tire and 67 L tank use PRELIMINARY OEM introduction data, not independently production-confirmed. No optional Premium Sport 18-inch wheels, sunroof or automatic mass assumed.

6700 electronic cutoff, 800 idle, differential 0/0, CG .52m, Cd .34, steering ratio 16, 21 US mpg, 145 mph/6.5 sec display, torque interpolation and normalized handling/brake/shift/launch parameters are estimates. No unsupported MIVEC switching discontinuity or LSD assumed. Nominal tire radius .3284m is not loaded rolling radius.
Original individually fitted LHD blank cockpit, shared runtime wheel and upper-opening gauges, fixed rear camera and surface tire smoke/spray only.
